# Cover letter — Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise at Tavily

Karthikeyan Devadoss  
Berlin, Germany · itskarthiksid@yahoo.com · +49 1521 0924553  
https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/tavily/jobs/4976971101?gh_jid=4976971101

Dear Hiring Team,

Your about page puts it plainly: connect AI agents to the web, with fresh, structured context so they stay grounded from prototype to production. That matches the bottleneck I keep solving when I build agent workflows — search built for clicks is not enough when models need relevance without burning tokens. I am writing about the Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise role.

**What I bring**
- About ten years of Java/Spring backend work, including US large-enterprise delivery: Marsh in Phoenix (Bluestream / Digital Broker for Affinity — ~95,000 colleagues across 130 countries) and BCBSA in Chicago (national hub connecting state Blue Cross Blue Shield plans, ~118 million members system-wide).
- Since early 2026, one of a handful of engineers in an initial core AI team at a large retail-energy company: production AI triage with Azure OpenAI, vector retrieval, and a human approval step before any action, now used by several teams.
- Own agentic software-delivery platform (live): approval-gated agents, RAG with labelled retrieval evals, MCP tool boundaries — public proof that search and RAG work can hold up past a demo.

**How it fits this role**
- Hands-on RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and evaluation loops — the same work your FDE brief describes doing with customer teams.
- Strong backend and API background for custom integrations and reference architectures on a production retrieval stack.
- Comfortable sitting with enterprises on ambiguous integration work and shipping reference patterns they can reuse.

Production safeguards on your product side — privacy, injection resistance, source quality — line up with how I already design: human approval before action, labelled retrieval evals, and clear tool boundaries. At this point in my career I want that customer-facing, architecture-adjacent seat, building retrieval systems that enterprises can trust in production.

If agents are going to earn a real place on the web, they need clean context first — that is the bet Tavily is making, and it is the work I want to do with your customers.

Kind regards,  
Karthikeyan Devadoss
